title: Free-first pricing for secure document sharing and lightweight VDR workflows
subtitle: Start with Free, then upgrade when you need more storage or team capacity. Paid plans include a 14-day trial on Essential with no credit card required.

allPlansInclude.title: All paid plans include full room controls from day one
allPlansInclude.subtitle: Free is intentionally constrained for lightweight sharing. Paid plans unlock unrestricted uploads, branding controls, and deeper version retention.
items: High-fidelity PDF-first viewer through DocKosha Cloud’s validated document-processing path
Data rooms with folder access controls and aggregated analytics
Link gates: password, email verification, allowlists/blocklists (emails + groups), custom NDA templates
Privacy-first viewer analytics (views, time per page, downloads)
Verified viewer commenting (pinned to highlighted text)
Document version history (retention controls, preview, restore) on paid plans
Link presets for fast reuse of secure configurations
Owner-only internal audit logs for workspace activity
Custom domains and branding removal on paid plans

engineKeys.title: Source access and Cloud availability
engineKeys.subtitle: DocKosha source is published under AGPL-3.0-or-later for reading and contribution. DocKosha Cloud is the available hosted product; external self-hosting and DocYantra access are not currently available.

items.title: What powers DocKosha Cloud
items.body: DocYantra provides document conversion through the validated Office and PDF fidelity envelope inside DocKosha Cloud. Outside a validated format, size, and fidelity envelope, conversion fails closed with a typed reason and the viewer serves the original file unchanged.

items.title: Private processing dependency
items.body: DocYantra is the mandatory private direct 0.0.26 dependency for this application. It is not offered as a package, SDK, API, standalone product, or engine license to external users.

items.title: Enterprise is a separate agreement
items.body: The AGPL-3.0-or-later DocKosha source and any Enterprise agreement are distinct. Enterprise terms require a separate signed agreement and do not imply access to the private DocYantra engine.

cta.label: Explore DocKosha Cloud
cta.note: DocKosha Cloud is available for hosted use. Enterprise terms require a separate signed agreement; contact us for commercial terms without implying engine access.

items.q: How does monthly vs annual billing work?
items.a: Monthly plans are billed every month. Annual plans are billed upfront and include 30% off compared to monthly pricing.

items.q: Can I switch plans or billing intervals later?
items.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or switch billing intervals any time. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated by Stripe.

items.q: Do you charge per user or per viewer?
items.a: No. Pricing is workspace-based, so teams can add internal collaborators and share externally without per-user or per-viewer fees.

items.q: What happens when we hit included storage?
items.a: Uploads are blocked once included storage is exhausted until you delete files or upgrade. Storage reflects total workspace usage and does not reset monthly.
Essential includes a 14-day trial with no credit card required.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Credit and debit cards. For annual invoicing or larger contracts, contact sales.

items.q: What does the Free plan include?
items.a: Free includes 250 MB storage, 2 GB monthly bandwidth, one workspace member, and PDF-only uploads. It keeps DocKosha branding, does not support custom domains, and does not retain previous versions.
